answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in falcon, verified in knoll, and quill names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 15 submissions per epoch. Repeating the trick 14 times costs 9 separate deposits and 41 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
